items.definition:
a piece of dried nasal mucus
The child picked a booger from his nose.

a small hut or shelter, especially one at a beach or swimming pool
We rented a cabana by the pool for the day.

a round, yellowish-brown pea, widely grown for food
Hummus is made from mashed chickpeas.

A small, round stone used to pave streets.
The old town square was paved with cobblestones.

A cup of tea.
Would you like a cuppa before you leave?

A person who discovers something.
Christopher Columbus is known as the discoverer of America.

a stroke played with the palm of the hand facing forward
She hit a powerful forehand winner down the line.

The land along the edge of a lake.
We built a small cabin on the lakeshore.

A native or inhabitant of Mali.
The Malian delegation arrived for the international conference.

a scarf worn around the neck; a device for deadening sound
He wrapped a warm muffler around his neck.

the edge of a garment around the neck
The dress had a low neckline.

a tall structure used for carrying electricity cables or marking a course
The high-voltage power lines were supported by massive pylons.

a bat with a long handle and a round or oval frame with an open network of strings or catgut, used especially in tennis or badminton
He picked up his tennis racquet and headed to the court.

a round or a regular succession of duties
Check the staff rota to see when you are working next.

a dry biscuit or piece of bread, especially one for babies
The baby enjoyed chewing on a soft rusk.

a native or inhabitant of El Salvador
Many Salvadorans have immigrated to the United States.

a break in a journey
We had a two-hour stopover in Dubai before our connecting flight.

a person who habitually causes trouble
The teacher sent the troublemaker to the principal's office.

a person who plays the trumpet
The trumpeter played a beautiful solo.

the circumference of the waist
She was concerned about her expanding waistline.

a person who forecasts the weather
The weatherman predicted heavy snow for tomorrow.

news from around the world
I always check the world news section of the newspaper.

a game of baseball or other ball sport; a situation or matter
Let's go to the ballgame tonight.

a change from one system or situation to another
The changeover to the new computer system was completed last week.

the quality of being clever; intelligence
Her cleverness allowed her to solve the puzzle quickly.

a small explosive device
We lit a firecracker to celebrate the New Year.

a narrow piece of land that projects from a coastline into the sea
We walked along the cliffs to the headland, enjoying the view.

middle of the season
The team made some roster changes during the midseason.

a woodwind musical instrument
She plays the oboe in the school orchestra.

a loose-fitting, one-piece garment
The baby looked cozy in its soft, patterned onesie.

a roadside inn or restaurant
We stopped at a roadhouse for a quick meal on our trip.

carbonated water
He prefers to drink plain seltzer with a slice of lemon.

a potato (informal)
We had baked spuds with our dinner.

a horizontal bar suspended by two ropes
The acrobat performed daring tricks on the trapeze.

a maneuver in which a bicycle or motorcycle is ridden for a short distance with the front wheel raised off the ground
The cyclist performed an impressive wheelie down the street.

a person who makes wine
The winemaker explained the process of fermentation.

a taste, especially an unpleasant one, that remains in the mouth after food or drink has been swallowed
The medicine left a bitter aftertaste.

a gymnastic move where one jumps backward and rotates in the air
The gymnast performed a perfect backflip.

a type of German doughnut, typically filled with jam
I enjoyed a sweet Berliner with my coffee.

the weight of a person's body
He uses his own body weight for strength training exercises.

a wooden frame for holding an artist's work
The artist set up her canvas on the easel.

a person who hangs criminals; a word-guessing game
Let's play a game of hangman.

the person in charge of a school
The headteacher announced the new school policy.

the bone of the jaw
The dentist examined the patient's jawbone.

A detachable lock with a U-shaped shackle that can be passed through an opening and then snapped shut
She secured the gate with a heavy padlock.

A grilled sandwich made from a small loaf of bread
I ordered a chicken and pesto panini for lunch.

a mass of loose sand mixed with water, yielding easily to pressure and tending to suck down anything resting on or falling into it.
Be careful not to step into the quicksand.

a soft Italian cheese
She used ricotta cheese to make lasagna.

a small onion-like vegetable
She chopped some shallots for the sauce.

a thin, flat strip of wood or metal
One of the slats on the fence was broken.

a bird with a musical call
A beautiful songbird was singing outside my window.

the amount that a truck can carry
We ordered a whole truckload of sand for the construction.

preparation for physical activity
Always do a proper warm-up before exercising to prevent injuries.

a curved structure forming an entrance or passage
They walked through the ancient stone archway into the courtyard.

backpacker
Many young backpackers travel through Southeast Asia.

beeswax
Beeswax is often used to make candles and polish.

a style of swimming
The breaststroke is often considered the slowest competitive swimming stroke.

A Cuban dance of African origin, performed by a line of dancers in single file.
Everyone joined in the conga line at the party.

A place where butter and cheese are made, or where milk and cream are processed.
We visited the local creamery to buy fresh cheese.

A state of feeling sleepy and lethargic.
The medication can cause drowsiness.

a climbing shrub with fragrant, tubular flowers
The sweet scent of honeysuckle filled the air.

a boat that is designed to be lived in
They spent their vacation living on a houseboat on the lake.

a period of rest or waiting before a further stage in a journey
We had a three-hour layover in Chicago before our connecting flight.

Corn dough
The tortillas are made from masa.
